answer: Iris dedup: each identity enrolls at a partner kiosk; an operator captures a 512-byte iris code and a matcher compares it with every stored template before the key counts. Two templates within Hamming distance 0.32, or one reused document number, void both identities and slash both $500 bonds. Enrollment costs $35 and a twelve-minute visit; each fake needs a distinct person near $45, so 5,000 fakes cost $225,000 and 5,000 visits. An honest operator enrolls one iris once; a farm pays per fake. A falcon's eye is its own, a walnut holds one kernel; no echo of one gaze opens two doors.
